Young Dan Godfrey, many will remember his father, who was a walker in Len Fletcher's day, ran a good race in the 440 yards, but was unable to stave off the strong Wallington boy's finish in the last few yards.
Harry Churcher once again won the Business Houses 2 Miles Track Championship, with Bob McMullen 2nd and at the same meeting young Dan Godfrey won the 100 and 200 Youths' events.
Plummer for a very fine trophy for this event, and the first holder proved to be young Dan Godfrey who looks a most promising prospect at this distance.
